payload.name: Machine-like ISA effectiveness
payload.fact: Machine-like intelligent service agents (ISAs) are more effective for utilitarian products, whereas human-like ISAs are more effective for social products.
payload.boundary: Interaction frequency acts as a key boundary condition for the effectiveness of ISA appearance.

provenance.title: How AI appearance shapes consumer responses: the interactive effects of intelligent service agent design, product type and interaction frequency
provenance.quote_or_locus: Results demonstrate that, machine-like ISAs are more effective for utilitarian products, whereas human-like ISAs are more effective for social products
